name: FAERS case by ID
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase {case_id: '10016781'}) RETURN c.age, c.sex, c.country

name: Top reported drugs
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 15

name: Top adverse reactions
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 15

name: Cases by country
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL RETURN c.country, count(c) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: Cases by sex
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.sex IS NOT NULL RETURN c.sex, count(c) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Drug reaction pairs
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug {name: 'ASPIRIN'}) WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: Reaction to drug reverse lookup
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction {preferred_term: 'DEATH'}) WITH c LIMIT 1000 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: Total FAERS cases
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) RETURN count(c) AS total_cases

name: Total unique drugs
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug) WHERE d.name IS NOT NULL RETURN count(d) AS total_drugs

name: Total unique reactions
cypher: MATCH (r:Reaction) RETURN count(r) AS total_reactions

name: Elderly cases (age > 65)
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.age > 65 RETURN count(c) AS elderly_cases

name: Pediatric cases (age < 18)
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.age < 18 AND c.age > 0 RETURN count(c) AS pediatric_cases

name: US cases count
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase {country: 'US'}) RETURN count(c) AS us_cases

name: Drugs with most reactions
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WITH d, count(DISTINCT c) AS cases WHERE cases > 100 WITH d, cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 20 MATCH (c2:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d) WITH d, cases, c2 LIMIT 5000 MATCH (c2)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN d.name, cases, count(DISTINCT r.preferred_term) AS unique_reactions ORDER BY unique_reactions DESC LIMIT 10

name: Parkinsonism adverse events
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) WHERE r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'PARKINSON' RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC

name: Levodopa adverse events
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'LEVODOPA' WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: Metformin adverse events
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'METFORMIN' WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: Statin drug reactions
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'STATIN' WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: Female vs male case ratio
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.sex IN ['F', 'M'] RETURN c.sex, count(c) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

name: Average age of cases
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.age > 0 AND c.age < 120 RETURN avg(c.age) AS avg_age

name: Cases per drug (top 20)
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 20

name: Rhabdomyolysis reports
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction {preferred_term: 'RHABDOMYOLYSIS'}) RETURN count(c) AS rhabdomyolysis_cases

name: Hepatotoxicity drugs
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) WHERE r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'HEPAT' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: QT prolongation drugs
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) WHERE r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'QT PROLONGATION' OR r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'TORSADE' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: FAERS node label counts
cypher: MATCH (n:AdverseEventCase) RETURN 'AdverseEventCase' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:Reaction) RETURN 'Reaction' AS label, count(n) AS cnt

name: FAERS edge type counts
cypher: MATCH ()-[r:REPORTED_DRUG]->() RETURN 'REPORTED_DRUG' AS edge, count(r) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH ()-[r:EXPERIENCED]->() RETURN 'EXPERIENCED' AS edge, count(r) AS cnt

name: Polypharmacy cases (5+ drugs)
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WITH c, count(d) AS drug_count WHERE drug_count >= 5 RETURN count(c) AS polypharmacy_cases

name: Serious reaction - death
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction {preferred_term: 'DEATH'}) WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS deaths ORDER BY deaths DESC LIMIT 10

name: Warfarin interactions
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d1:Drug {name: 'WARFARIN'}) WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d2:Drug) WHERE d2.name <> 'WARFARIN' RETURN d2.name, count(c) AS co_reports ORDER BY co_reports DESC LIMIT 10

name: Cross-KG drug to gene bridge
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]-(c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE d1.name = 'ASPIRIN' WITH d1 LIMIT 1 MATCH (d2:Drug {name: 'Aspirin'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN d2.name, g.gene_name LIMIT 10
